dedupe_keys.name: dataset for publication test bench and frequency response of a magnetic antenna used in gis pd measurements

description: TU Delft researchers publish the spreadsheet supporting their magnetic-antenna test-bench study for partial-discharge measurements in gas-insulated substations. The November 2021 Zenodo deposit is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0 and explicitly identifies the associated IEEE conference paper. The institutional abstract describes comparison of magnetic and conventional ultra-high-frequency antennas in the frequency domain up to one GHz and in the time domain with different pulse shapes. It also describes charge estimates using a double voltage integral and tests of current propagation in the transverse electromagnetic mode. These experimental results can calibrate sensor-response and insulation-monitoring components in substation simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this experiment. Coverage is a laboratory study, not an operational substation time series. Observation dates, spreadsheet sheet names, numerical units, sample spacing and uncertainty values remain unknown. The abstract establishes the experiment, but individual workbook columns and reproduction of the published figures were not independently checked.
